description.value:
Frequency once per round, separate from Flash Mob

Requirements One of Blaster's living Flash Mob Hype Thralls is within 60 feet.

Effect Blaster commands one qualifying thrall, gaining one of the following benefits until the start of his next turn.

  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterInspire01]{Inspire} A +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear.
  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterGuard0001]{Guard} A +1 status bonus to AC.
  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterTempHP001]{Bolster} 10 temporary HP. Higher existing temporary HP retain their original duration; only HP granted by Bolster expire with this benefit.

The thrall gains no movement or other actions.

Foundry @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterMobCmd001]{Command Thrall}
